text:
Noah CSM: Newton dedicated bring-up set for Mon 07:30 PST. Need final quota runway, autoscale config, and a short smoke + burst run. Renewal check in ~85d so want a tidy onboarding signal.
Eve SE: Requesting their steady vs burst numbers and typical token sizes.
Noah CSM: They sent a profile: steady 60rps, predictable campaign bursts to 700rps for 6-9m, nightly batch spikes +30rps. Avg payload ~75 tokens.
Tom SRE: Suggest runway = 6x steady (360rps) given nightly batch. Pre-approved burst headroom to 800rps for 10m before fallback. KV priming and prefix cache warmers required.
Yara Eng: I'll author an autoscale policy: min_replicas=1, target_rps=120, scale_step=+2, max_replicas=12, burst_policy=allow(10m)->route-to-quantized. Posting draft JSON after lunch.
Liam PM: Can we do shadow 20m then routed 12m at 30% traffic? Also schedule a 20m enablement session at 10:00 PST.
Noah CSM: Shadow->routed plan works. Enablement invite to Newton infra and product team at 10:00. I'll handle calendar.
Eve SE: Load plan (vegeta) I'll run: ```vegeta attack -rate=250 -duration=20m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > newton-shadow.json``` targets.txt will encode ramp/peaks.
Tom SRE: Add KV priming: ```for i in $(seq 1 1500); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/prime -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"warm-$i"}'; done``` run 30m before main.
opsbot: scheduler: created job nt-2024-4321 for 1745081400 (Mon 07:30 PST).
Yara Eng: Metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, fallback_count, token_throughput, cache_hit_ratio, GPU_util. Also collect small sample outputs when fallback occurs for quality triage.
Liam PM: Renewal risk rule: mark "Monitor" if p99>900ms or >0.7% fallbacks during routed soak; escalate to "At-Risk" if >1% 5xx or repeated fallbacks across runs.
Eve SE: I'll include a smoke harness that aborts routed step if 5xx >0.5% or p95>500ms.
Tom SRE: Canary plan: 10% for 45m -> 40% for 1h -> full. Rollback criteria: error delta >0.5% or CPU/GPU saturation alerts.
Noah CSM: Action items: Eve run shadow job, Yara post autoscale JSON, Tom provide warmup script & canary hooks, Liam send enablement invite, Noah will brief Newton on renewal thresholds.
Yara Eng: Draft autoscale posted: ```{ "min":1, "max":12, "target_rps":120, "burst_headroom":800, "burst_window_mins":10 }```
opsbot: run-complete: nt-2024-4321 -> status: shadow_ok, p95: 230ms, p99: 510ms, 5xx: 0.18% (artifacts: s3://newton/ns-321/nt-2024-4321)
Noah CSM: Shadow looks clean. Scheduling routed soak at 08:15 PST per plan.
Liam PM: Enablement invite sent to Newton infra + product.
Tom SRE: I'll monitor cache_hit_ratio during routed soak; if it drops <68% we pause and re-prime.
Eve SE: Uploading scripts and ramp CSV to case: NT-321.
Noah CSM: Thanks all. If routed soak passes, we'll close bring-up and produce a one-pager for the renewal deck.
